title: gladiolus segetum proles bornetii
intro:
Gladiolus segetum proles bornetii, commonly known as the Bornet's corn flag or gladiolus segetum subsp. bornetii, is a subspecies of the Gladiolus segetum plant, a type of flowering plant in the iris family, Iridaceae.

This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues, due to its potential health benefits such as reducing swelling and fighting off infections. The therapeutic actions of Gladiolus segetum proles bornetii include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
